justification: Both show schematic animals and anthropomorphic figures organised in horizontal registers, with quadrupeds in profile and at least one bird-like creature, which is about as generic as animal imagery gets. A depicts a crowded narrative hunting scene of many small, lively, running human figures swarming around large bulls and deer, while B shows a few large, isolated, static creatures (crouching quadruped, snake-like/reptilian forms, a bird with a rounded object) stacked in separate panels with no human action and no interaction between them, so no specific relationship, posture or composition is shared.
